start.problem: Existing owned matter APIs have no discoverable browser controls for inspecting instructions and source attribution, updating the commission or explicitly declaring and ending a bounded protective exception.
invariants: Render only served values, with unknown and unavailable distinct from empty or established.
Instruction descriptions do not grant trusted decision-making authority.
Extraction quality, documentary status and human confirmation remain separate.
Declaration is not a turn; only a separate explicit protective-triage action sends a turn.
Every asynchronous paint, write completion and subsequent action belongs to one session, matter, rail generation and dialog generation.
No privileged field persists in browser storage; navigation and sign-out close and wipe the dialog.

cover_consistency_start.finding: Parent's actual browser intake showed a named client, saved activity and deadline on list/board while the cover read nonexistent Thread.our_role, Matter.touched_at and Thread.blocked_reason, ignored intake parties and discarded its supplied deadline register.
cover_consistency_start.contract: One saved matter must yield consistent client/activity/posture/deadline facts across its list, board and cover. Mixed, unknown and conflicting thread postures stay explicit. Existence of threads alone must not establish advising. Case deadlines and instruction/commission deadlines remain separate, including legacy commission field semantics.
planned_proof: Actual served intake, subsequent turn, list/board/cover and fresh store-reader restart agree
Unknown, partial, mixed and conflicting postures are not collapsed
Passed and uncomputed case deadlines remain visible separately from the next live date
Commission-only deadlines cannot establish a case register and case dates cannot replace the instruction deadline
Parent repeats the real browser cover check on current source
cover_consistency_start.implementation: Cover/list share the existing party resolver with a legacy engagement fallback. Cover reads actual Thread.posture and Matter.last_activity, names partial/mixed/conflicted positions, and does not infer advising from thread presence. A shared deadline projection consumes the strict RegisterRead authored by the other owner: known live, passed and uncomputed rows remain visible; unreadable/unassessed populations remain separate, including assessed-empty plus unassessed-thread incompleteness. Cover adds case_deadlines and explicitly retains old deadline fields as commission aliases. UI renders separate case and instruction sections. Attributed-file headings now use numbered statement/revision labels, retaining full stable identity as Record reference and all contradiction/supersession references.
cover_consistency_start.test_changes: 17 new Class-A cases in tests/test_the_cover_matches_the_saved_matter.py, one focused real-browser test in tests/test_the_matter_cover_in_the_browser.py, stronger existing Node cover/casefile witnesses. The closed board-status allowlists add only named read-accounting fields and retain every forbidden-analysis assertion. Existing passed_deadlines=None unassessed contract and legacy commission deadline assertions remain unchanged.
cover_consistency_start.lint: Ruff passed on projections.py and the three edited/new Python test files; no pytest or browser execution by this agent. Parent will run against frozen source.

findings: A matching matter ID in an HTTP-200 response did not prove the command succeeded; the returned state was unchecked
Commission forms omitted the version the user inspected, so a later stale form could overwrite newer instructions despite a per-request store CAS
reopened_start.contract: Confirm only the exact result state for the command; require the observed saved-matter version for every commission write, retaining the store CAS for races after the precondition read.
reopened_start.compatibility: Commission POST without expected_version now refuses422 deliberately. This endpoint has no plan-authorised unversioned-writer exception; known callers are the new UI and focused commission tests, migrated to explicit observed versions. The older turn endpoint's optional-version contract is unchanged.
proof: Positive-ID unknown/malformed successful HTTP replies do not yield confirmation or refresh
Two forms observing the same real saved version: first accepted, second409 and canonical instructions/history unchanged
Missing, bool, string and negative versions rejected; future versions also409
Fresh read then edit remains usable; a competing write after the precondition still meets actual store CAS
reopened_start.implementation: Commission GET and POST expose saved-matter version; POST checks expected_version before any instruction/authority-refusal mutation and existing store CAS remains. Browser compares cover/commission versions and submits its captured observed version. Every command confirmation checks its exact state, and commission reopened must be boolean.
reopened_start.lint: Bounded Ruff check of composition.py, api.py, tools/served.py and three owned test files passed after fixing7 formatting findings. No pytest executed by this agent.

changes: Added discoverable matter toolbar and accessible dialog with text-only rendering, current-context guards and close/wipe on matter/session events.
Cover reads existing cover/commission endpoints, checks matching instruction versions, renders unknowns/history/refusals and does not infer authority from descriptive parties.

Commission form submits existing wire fields including separate instructing and deciding parties, deadline kind/date/basis/reason, exclusions, constraints and version-change reason. Shared board refreshes the saved file version after successful writes.

Casefile reads existing projection: certainty, human confirmation, reading quality, attributed location, contradictions, supersession and integrity warnings remain separate. No source-opening link is invented.

Protective dialog reads governing exception/expiry/history, declares 1–24 hours with basis, revokes explicitly and rechecks the live exception before a separate protective_triage send. Declaration never sends a turn.
Added ten behavioral Node witnesses executing the shipped controller plus one asset-load-order test. Runtime absence remains NOT ASSESSED; tests were not executed by this agent.
